notes.title: Alpha Terminus Demo update
notes.content:
[h1][b]We are excited to share the following notes for the new update![/b][/h1]

[h2]News[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cockpit visual update
[*] Added animated arms in the cockpit (base POC)
[*] Added animated cockpit (tilting)
[*] Added skippable cutscenes with voice and subtitle
[*] New menu scene
[*] New in-game menu
[*] Added in-game subtitle
[*] Updated control
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173253/f0a181e044c48d19fe7cd7475b2133fb80d29fbc.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed jittering in cockpit movement
[*] Added deadzone for stick-based inputs
[*] Bound the mouse cursor for the game window
[/list]

[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Widescreen not fully supported
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Terminus
notes.content:
[h2]Stream for Next Fest 2023 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199147347230][u][b]GAMEPLAY HERE[/b][/u][/url][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173253/244f98462c593d1d999c83635de4bf8067f2df42.png[/img]
One of the Outer Houses launches a series of attacks against an Inner House on the 3rd of the 714th galactic year, so The League hired us to sabotage the mines.
We are the "Worm Dwellers" of the despised mutant caste who can handle the harshness of hyperspace.
THE HYPERSPACE IS US!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173253/f0298f18be341870b7eeb9c8c8d65e6e317705db.png[/img]
